title: Stage 2: PICO VR chain hooks, ExtPackageParserUtils, android.pico.ns, PicoSystemConfig

explained_differences.Landroid/app/ActivityThread;: <init>: the factory creates the extension through com.pico.util.ExtImplFactory reflection and also initialises Smartisan mMonitorEx/mSmtEx; Source creates ExtActivityThreadImpl directly.
explained_differences.Landroid/app/ExtActivityThreadImpl;: isActivityForceRender keeps the Source null check for ActivityClientRecord.activity (one extra field read); the factory throws NullPointerException there.
explained_differences.Landroid/content/pm/ExtPackageParserImpl: parseVrFlags: all references match; D8 allocates one extra const/4 1 differently.
explained_differences.Landroid/content/pm/PackageParser;: <init>: ExtImplFactory reflection instead of direct creation; parseBaseApkCommon: the factory uses the later Android 10 getSplitPermissions()/SplitPermissionInfoParcelable revision; parsePackage: Smartisan PackageParserSmtBase.verifyLibraryFiles.
explained_differences.Landroid/view/Display;: <init>: ExtImplFactory reflection instead of direct creation of ExtDisplayImpl.
